Any user with a valid invite to any workspace can join arbitrary corporate workspaces as an administrator.

corrected_code:
@router.post("/organizations/invites/accept")
async def accept_workspace_invitation(
    payload: InvitationAcceptancePayload,
    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db)
):
    stmt = select(WorkspaceInvite).where(
        WorkspaceInvite.token == payload.invite_token,
        WorkspaceInvite.status == "PENDING"
    )
    invite = await db.scalar(stmt)
    if not invite:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Invitation token not found or already accepted")

    new_membership = WorkspaceMember(
        workspace_id=invite.workspace_id,
        user_id=current_user.id,
        role=invite.designated_role
    )
    db.add(new_membership)
    invite.status = "ACCEPTED"
    await db.commit()

    return {"status": "joined", "workspace_id": invite.workspace_id}
